Function reference

Design an array

Place receivers on a depth raster, map the share of water they cover, and score the layout by the positioning error of simulated animals.

place_receivers()
Place receivers on the water cells of a raster
plot(<receiver_layout>)
Map a receiver layout
coverage_summary()
Water cells that at least one receiver hears on its own
evaluate_array()
Score a receiver array by simulation
plot(<array_evaluation>)
Map the positioning error of an array evaluation
score_surfaces()
Score location surfaces against known positions
perturb_de_model()
A detection model with its range shifted, for misspecification tests

Simulate tracks and detections

Walk animals through the water, with a preference for a habitat layer if you give one, send transmissions along their tracks, and hear them through the detection field.

movement_model()
A movement model for the walker
crw_model()
A correlated random walk with gamma steps
habitat_selection()
Give a movement model a preference for a habitat layer
track_control()
Settings for the walker
simulate_tracks()
Simulate animal tracks on a water raster
available_steps()
Available steps for a step selection check on simulated tracks
plot(<sim_tracks>)
Map simulated tracks
scale_colour_tracks()
Colours for simulated tracks
simulate_transmissions()
Simulate tag transmissions along tracks
simulate_detections()
Simulate detections of transmissions by a receiver array
